Create a gcms_fid_exp object from raw data

gcms_fid_exp.Rd

High-level constructor for a GC-FID/MS experiment from MS and FID matrices.

Usage

gcms_fid_exp(
  ms_data,
  fid_rt,
  fid_intensity,
  ms_metadata = list(),
  fid_metadata = list()
)

Arguments

ms_data

Numeric matrix with columns rt, mz, intensity (long format), or matrix with row scans, column m/z (dense format) with rt and tic as attributes.

fid_rt

Numeric vector; FID retention times (min).

fid_intensity

Numeric vector; FID intensities (pA).

ms_metadata

List; metadata for MS detector.

fid_metadata

List; metadata for FID detector.

Value

A gcms_fid_exp object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  # From long-format MS data
  exp <- gcms_fid_exp(
    ms_data = ms_long,  # matrix: rt, mz, intensity
    fid_rt = fid$rt,
    fid_intensity = fid$intensity,
    ms_metadata = list(sample_name = "sample1"),
    fid_metadata = list(units = "pA")
  )
} # }
